subject: FishingInfo.xml pond fish lists
claim: Pond fish lists are stored in the FishingInfo.xml entry of a GameData archive, separately from the WizZoneData object in gamedata.bin. The root class is FishingInfo, whose m_bodyOfWaterList contains BodyOfWater entries; each BodyOfWater has m_waterX (float), m_waterY (float), m_secondsToRespawn (unsigned int), m_numberOfFish (int), m_waterType (int), and m_zoneFishList. Each ZoneFish has m_fishTemplateID (unsigned int), m_creationChance (float), m_alternateLootChance (float), and m_alternateLootTableName (string).
how_to_repeat: Build the extractor, bindecode and client tools from this repository revision and use the type dump built from your own r806919.Wizard_1_610 install.
Run `extractor --client <install> --type-dump <dump.json> --sql <temporary.sql> zones` to obtain the complete zone-path-to-archive catalog.

For each `*.wad` in `<install>/Data/GameData`, run `bindecode --client <install> --wad <archive.wad> --list FishingInfo.xml`; for each archive that lists the entry, run `bindecode --client <install> --type-dump <dump.json> --wad <archive.wad> FishingInfo.xml` and count the root's `m_bodyOfWaterList` entries.

Use the first segment of each corresponding `zone_path` from the extracted zone catalog to group the pond counts by world. The archive `Raids-Raid_AZ.wad` has no `gamedata.bin`; group its FishingInfo.xml count under Raids using the archive family name.
Run `client --client <install> --type-dump <dump.json> types FishingInfo BodyOfWater ZoneFish` to verify each class's property names and types.
evidence: The client type dump defines FishingInfo.m_bodyOfWaterList as a list of SharedPointer<BodyOfWater>, and BodyOfWater.m_zoneFishList as a list of SharedPointer<ZoneFish>.

The type dump gives BodyOfWater the fields m_waterX, m_waterY, m_secondsToRespawn, m_numberOfFish, m_waterType and m_zoneFishList; it gives ZoneFish the fields m_fishTemplateID, m_creationChance, m_alternateLootChance and m_alternateLootTableName.
Decoding WizardCity-WC_Hub.wad's FishingInfo.xml with the client tool returns a FishingInfo root containing three BodyOfWater entries, with their fish-list lengths 28, 24 and 28.

A current-revision extractor scan read 3,599 GameData archives and produced 3,366 zone-template rows. Scanning all 3,599 archives for FishingInfo.xml found 132 entries; all 132 decoded as FishingInfo. 131 archives map to extracted zone paths. Raids-Raid_AZ.wad has no gamedata.bin and is the one additional archive grouped under Raids.

Pond counts by top-level zone path (the Raids count includes the unpaired Raids-Raid_AZ.wad): Aquila 2; Avalon 17; Azteca 42; Celestia 15; DragonSpire 91; G14_DM 1; G14_HS 1; G14_SB 2; Grizzleheim 16; Housing 21; Housing_Acropolis 1; Housing_AeroVillage 2; Housing_AV_OutlawHouse 6; Housing_AZ_BAC 3; Housing_BeeHouse 3; Housing_BotanicalGardens 4; Housing_BuildACastleProto 15; Housing_Darkmoor 2; Housing_DM_GraveholmInn 1; Housing_FairytaleFarm 2; Housing_FishingRetreat 2; Housing_FlotsamCantina 3; Housing_Gauntlet_Voyage 10; Housing_GH_BlacksmithFjord 2; Housing_GreatBelow 1; Housing_KaramelVillage 2; Housing_KR_PeppergrassGlen 2; Housing_KT_RiverPalace 13; Housing_LightkeepersEstate 1; Housing_LM_StreetHouse 3; Housing_Mirage_Tents 1; Housing_Novus 1; Housing_Polaris_Ship 4; Housing_PyramidOfTheLost 3; Housing_SeaVillage 1; Housing_SkyCastle 2; Housing_SP 5; Housing_SP_CottageCore 2; Housing_SteamSkyCastle 2; Housing_SunPal 2; Housing_Wallaru_Ranch 1; Housing_WaterMoleResort 1; Housing_Winter_Wind_Tower 1; Housing_WizardKeep 1; Khrysalis 16; Krokotopia 6; Marleybone 1; MonthlyEvents 2; MooShu 22; Raids 14; WizardCity 13; Zafaria 13.
